cliHelp:
GameEngineLauncher233, a game engine launcher for Unity, Tuanjie, Godot and community adapters.

Usage:
  gameenginelauncher233 projects [--query text]           list projects
  gameenginelauncher233 editors                         list installed editors
  gameenginelauncher233 open <path|name>                open a project in its editor
  gameenginelauncher233 new <folder> [--editor version] create a project
  gameenginelauncher233 hub status                      show the hubs taken over
  gameenginelauncher233 hub sync                        add added projects to the hubs
  gameenginelauncher233 releases                        list the editors to install
  gameenginelauncher233 install <version> [--simulate]  install an editor
  gameenginelauncher233 update                          check for a newer release
  gameenginelauncher233 version                         print the version

Flags:
  --json      print JSON
  --lang      en or zh-Hans
  --verbose   log to the terminal

With no command, the window opens.
